name: Polearm Master
summary: +1 Str or Dex; Bonus Action butt-end attack (d4 Bludgeoning) and a Reaction attack when foes enter your reach.

benefits.name: Pole Strike
benefits.summary: After attacking with a Quarterstaff, Spear or Heavy Reach weapon, Bonus Action attack with the other end (d4).
benefits.text: Immediately after you take the Attack action and attack with a Quarterstaff, a Spear or a weapon that has both the Heavy and Reach properties, you can use a Bonus Action to make a melee attack with the opposite end of the weapon. That attack deals Bludgeoning damage, and the weapon's damage die for it is a d4.

benefits.name: Reactive Strike
benefits.summary: Reaction: attack a creature that enters your reach while you hold a Quarterstaff, Spear or Heavy Reach weapon.
benefits.text: While you are holding a Quarterstaff, a Spear or a weapon that has both the Heavy and Reach properties, you can take a Reaction to make one melee attack against a creature that enters the reach you have with that weapon.
